action.objective: Complete broad search over all 10 legal White moves at depth 4 to identify the best defensive resources.
action.rationale: Phase is broad_search and no prior analyses exist. Must use candidate_moves=[] with depth up to 4, spending at most 3000 nodes (half of 6000). White is down a rook and queen for rook, so this is a lost endgame; goal is to find the move minimizing material loss and maximizing practical chances.
